correctness.rationale: Any admissible word of length at least 2 starts with one of eight allowed ordered pairs. The inversion-preserving permutation taking any such pair to 01 is unique, so the normalization loses no orbits and the final orbit has size eight. Alternating parity excludes exactly equal-letter and inverse-letter adjacent pairs; the repetition search handles all other constraints. A new forbidden factor after an append must be a suffix. For each p, it suffices to inspect the suffix of length ceil(7p/4), if present: any longer suffix of period p has a suffix of that length of the same period. This tests the inclusive threshold, regardless of whether the candidate period is least. The independent replay used masked two-bit comparisons for those shortest suffixes and computed D_3 from the actual sets of pairs and triples. Its length-24 probe found 350 normalized words; its full run found 414112 at length 67 with exactly the specified qualifying word, and 486776 at length 68, all pair-complete, with d3 counts 397780, 83006, 5990 for 0, 1, 2. It separately scanned the witness's factors and checked its palindrome and exact D_3={010,101,303}. Pair-completeness at length 68 ensures that further extensions can only remove minimal absent triples, so no longer qualifying word is missed; d3 need not be monotone on arbitrary incomplete prefixes. Independent reproduction: python3 /workspace/branches/4607a331-6161-4173-aef5-5e141050614b/replay.py, with exit-zero results in replay_counts.txt in the same directory.
